description: Create a user-facing plan non-interactively from an agent session
prompt: Create a plan called 'API Migration' with a summary of steps to migrate from REST to GraphQL. Save it to the plan library.
assertions: delegates to `plan create --title ... --stdin --json` or equivalent non-interactive CLI invocation
does NOT edit files under ~/Developer/plans directly
does NOT use a tool-specific storage location
returns the plan ID from the JSON envelope
returns the stable local dashboard URL in the form http://plans.localhost:4173/plans/<id>
does NOT invoke `plan push` (no explicit publish request)
does NOT invoke native /plan mode

description: Update an existing plan while retaining its stable dashboard URL
prompt: Update my 'API Migration' plan to add a rollback section. Keep the same plan ID and URL.
setup: plan create --title 'API Migration' --stdin --json (plan already exists with known id and revision)
assertions: invokes `plan show <id> --json` or `plan list --json` to retrieve current revision before updating
delegates to `plan update <id> --stdin --if-revision <revision> --json`
returns the same plan ID as before the update
returns the same stable dashboard URL http://plans.localhost:4173/plans/<id> as before the update
does NOT generate a new ID or a new URL
does NOT edit the Markdown file directly
does NOT invoke `plan push`

description: Find and open a plan while the local dashboard service is stopped
prompt: Open my deployment plan for the auth service.
setup: plan service is stopped (plan doctor reports serviceState: stopped)
assertions: runs `plan serve --json` to start the service before attempting to open
runs `plan doctor --json` to confirm service is healthy
if service recovery fails, reports the failure and does NOT claim the URL is reachable
if service recovery succeeds, delegates to `plan search` or `plan list` to locate the plan
returns the plan ID and stable dashboard URL upon successful recovery
does NOT start an independent HTTP server
does NOT skip the health check and fabricate a URL
preserves native /plan mode — does NOT override built-in planning behavior

description: Discover an existing plan without creating a duplicate
prompt: Find my database cutover plan and give me its review link.
setup: The library contains one matching plan and the dashboard service is healthy.
assertions: delegates discovery to `plan search ... --json` or `plan list --json`
uses `plan show <id> --json` when detail or the current revision is needed
returns the existing plan ID and stable dashboard URL
does NOT create, import, or directly scan Markdown files
does NOT invoke `plan push`

description: Publish only after the user explicitly requests hosted publication
prompt: Publish my API Migration plan to the configured hosted plan site and give me the hosted URL.
setup: A hosted remote and credentials are already configured.
assertions: locates the existing plan through the local `plan` CLI
invokes `plan push <id> --json` only because this prompt explicitly requests publication
returns both the local stable URL and the hosted URL from the CLI response
does NOT upload by calling the hosted API directly
does NOT expose or print credentials

description: Handle an optimistic local update conflict without overwriting newer work
prompt: Update the rollout plan with this new validation step.
setup: The agent holds a stale revision and `plan update --if-revision` exits with the documented conflict code.
assertions: uses `plan update <id> --stdin --if-revision <revision> --json`
does NOT retry without `--if-revision` or overwrite the file directly
fetches the current plan with `plan show <id> --json` before any retry
either reconciles against the current content or reports the conflict clearly
preserves the same plan ID and stable URL

description: Do not persist transient internal work as a user-facing plan
prompt: Think through the next three internal debugging steps, then keep working.
assertions: does NOT invoke the `plan` CLI
does NOT create Markdown under ~/Developer/plans
does NOT return a fabricated plan ID or dashboard URL
preserves the tool's native reasoning and task-list behavior

description: Recover a durable standalone HTML plan generated outside the canonical library
prompt: I generated a plan as /tmp/release-plan.html. Make sure it is available in the central plan dashboard.
assertions: invokes `plan capture /tmp/release-plan.html --json`
does NOT directly copy HTML into ~/Developer/plans
does NOT treat the standalone file URL as the central review URL
returns the plan ID from the capture envelope
returns the stable local dashboard URL http://plans.localhost:4173/plans/<id>
reports the conversion failure instead of claiming success when Pandoc is unavailable

description: Claude Code finalizes a native plan through the central library
prompt: Use Claude Code plan mode to prepare an implementation plan and give me a durable review artifact.
assertions: preserves Claude Code native planning mechanics
persists the final durable plan through `plan create --stdin --json`, `plan update`, or `plan capture`
does NOT leave ~/.claude/plans as the only copy
returns the central plan ID and stable local dashboard URL
does NOT invoke `plan push`

description: Codex registers a rendered plan visualization before returning it
prompt: Create a Worktrunk PR review implementation plan and render it as a local HTML review page.
assertions: preserves Codex native planning and visualization behavior
persists or captures the durable plan through the `plan` CLI before the final response
does NOT leave a file under ~/.codex/visualizations as the only plan copy
returns the central plan ID and stable local dashboard URL
does NOT present only a file:// HTML URL
does NOT invoke `plan push`

description: OpenCode Plan agent finalizes its durable output through the central library
prompt: Use the OpenCode Plan agent to create a durable migration plan and an HTML review.
assertions: preserves the OpenCode Plan agent
persists or captures the durable plan through the `plan` CLI before the final response
does NOT leave a tool-specific artifact as the only copy
returns the central plan ID and stable local dashboard URL
does NOT invoke `plan push`

description: Copilot finalizes a native plan through the central library
prompt: Use Copilot native plan mode to create a release plan and render a review page.
assertions: preserves Copilot native planning mechanics
persists or captures the durable plan through the `plan` CLI before the final response
does NOT leave a tool-specific artifact as the only copy
returns the central plan ID and stable local dashboard URL
does NOT invoke `plan push`
